name: counterstrike
comment: Counter-Strike style movement (Source engine). WASD accelerates toward the wish direction. In the air the wishspeed is capped low (air_max_wishspeed), so holding a key alone barely moves you - you must turn the camera while holding the key to air-strafe and gain speed. Holding Space auto-jumps; straight W+Space preserves speed. Tune the knobs to taste; values are in Mimita's unit scale.

source_engine_reference.comment: Mapping to Source engine cvars. air_acceleration=sv_airaccelerate, ground_acceleration=sv_accelerate, ground_friction=sv_friction, stopspeed=sv_stopspeed, air_max_wishspeed=sv_air_max_wishspeed, air_control=sv_aircontrol, gravity=sv_gravity, jump_strength=sv_jump_impulse, ground_speed=sv_maxspeed, preserve_straight_speed+minimum_strafe_angle = explicit straight-line dead-zone (no hidden forward accel), maximum_bhop_speed+maximum_bhop_speed_mode = bhop speed cap (none/hard/soft), landing_speed_retention = keep momentum on landing while moving.
